provenance.solver/bed_temperature_bracket: T_amb+10 K; fallback [T_amb+0.5 K, T_amb+10 K] iff the residual at T_amb+10 K is negative

minimum_pinch_k.source: repository default of heatnetwork (two exchanger stages of about 10 K in series); band of Befund 99

cold_temperature_celsius.source: repository default T_kalt of heatnetwork (cooling-water level); band of Befund 99

compressor_station_kw.source: partner: about 1200 kW waste heat of about 1300 kW electric (7 compressors), about 400 kW used today; mean of the band as main case

compressor_hot_in_celsius.source: brief: cooling water 50-80 degC; oil-injected screw compressors with heat recovery deliver 70-90 degC (manufacturer data, order of magnitude)

compressor_hot_out_celsius.source: brief: cooling water 50-80 degC; return band of Befund 99

compressor_used_today_kw.source: partner: up to about 400 kW of the compressor heat used today (compressor -> plant A); band +-25 %

compressor_c_gwh_per_a.source: partner annual figure of plant C compressor heat (Befund 99); band of Befund 99

exhaust_c_gwh_per_a.source: partner annual figure of the plant C exhaust heat (Befund 99); used only in the reading 'annual'

c_line_nm3_per_h.source: partner: 2 lines of about 20 000 m3/h each (read as Nm3/h as in Befund 99); band of Befund 99

c_low_temperature_today_kw.source: partner: about 200 kW of plant C heat recovery for hall heating and process water (planned design); band +-50 %

c_operating_fraction.source: no schedule of plant C known; 1 = continuous like plant A (partner: plant A 24/7); combined exactly from the runs with and without plant C

generic_flow_nm3_per_h.source: brief: further lines of the site as scaled copies of plant A, 10 000-30 000 m3/h (no data)

hall_kw.source: partner: up to about 200 kW for hall heating and process water; peak at the design temperature (Befund 99 profile)

hall_limit_celsius.source: heating limit temperature, common value for industrial halls (Befund 99)

hall_design_celsius.source: design outdoor temperature, order of magnitude for northern Germany (Befund 99)

hall_day_factor.source: Befund 99 placeholder: day share of the hall-heating demand (1 at night)

water_kw.source: partner: up to about 200 kW for hall heating and process water; constant (Befund 99)

solid_fraction.source: solid fraction of the sprayed suspension for the exhaust humidity reconstruction; the energy balance of the two measured days of plant A requires at least 0.575 (product 1) and 0.625 (product 2), 0.634 fits both (parallel study 4, branch plant-a-operating-point, docs/23 section 5); the 0.3 of Befund 99 (band 0.2-0.5) is inadmissible and is kept only as the variant 'Befund 99 assumption'

relative_humidity.source: relative humidity of the intake air (storage A1 convention, Befund 91/99)

normal_density_kg_per_nm3.source: normal density of air (convention of storage A1, Befund 91)

gas_efficiency.source: useful heat per fuel (LHV) of steam heater and direct burner; repository default of heatnetwork

electricity_co2_kg_per_kwh.source: carrier_energy (UBA, project description); low end = variant '2030' (placeholder 0.20)

network_pump_fraction.source: pump electricity per kWh of transported heat; district-heating networks 0.5-3 % (literature order of magnitude)

heat_pump_carnot_efficiency.source: exergetic efficiency of industrial heat pumps 0.4-0.6 of Carnot (review literature, e.g. high-temperature heat pump surveys)

boiler_flue_celsius.source: flue gas after a shell steam boiler without economiser (manufacturer data, order of magnitude); variant only

boiler_excess_air.source: air ratio of a gas-fired boiler (literature order of magnitude); variant only

climate_shift_k.source: uniform shift of the monthly means below (warm/cold year)
